question: Which hill is **NOT **a part of the Meghalaya Plateau?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nilgiri Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Nilgiri hills

 
 
• The Nilgiri hills are located in the Northwestern part of Tamil Nadu. 
 
• It consists of 24 peaks with more than 2,000 meters in height.
